entities.name: Elongation factor Ts
observations: The 287-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed Pseudomonas putida elongation factor Ts entries A5W849 and closely matching entries Q88MH9 and B0KSA0.
EF-Ts is a guanine-nucleotide exchange factor for EF-Tu: it associates with EF-Tu·GDP and promotes GDP release/GTP loading during bacterial translation.
The protein is cytoplasmic and has GO molecular function translation elongation factor activity (GO:0003746).
The sequence contains the EF_TS Pfam domain PF00889.26 at positions 79–265 with i-Evalue 1.8e-54.
The sequence is 287 aa and approximately 30.4 kDa; predicted pI is 5.14 and calculated charge at pH 7 is -8.27.
No explicit catalytic reaction equation or cofactor requirement was retrieved; EF-Ts is a non-enzymatic nucleotide-exchange factor rather than a metabolic catalyst.

entities.name: EF-Tu
observations: EF-Ts acts on the EF-Tu·GDP complex to promote GDP-to-GTP exchange before EF-Tu participates in aminoacyl-tRNA delivery to the ribosome.
